explication: Microsoft Agent Framework for Go lets developers build production agents and graph-based multi-agent workflows. The principal flow is: an application submits messages to an agent, middleware governs execution, a provider requests model output, and tool calls or workflow steps produce streamed responses. Conversation history may be compacted to fit context limits. Workflows add routing, concurrency, checkpointing, external human interaction, and observability. The tree and README establish the major integrations; several provider and workflow relationships are represented at package level because their implementations were not sampled.
